name: Access Profile Cleanup Notification
description: Sent to a user when their access profiles change due to deleted entitlements on the source.
subject: Access profiles updated after deleted entitlements were detected
body:
Access profile cleanup notification

Dear ${user.name},

Following recent entitlement aggregation and system refresh activity, entitlement changes were detected on the source. As a result, updates were applied to your access profiles in Identity Security Cloud.

#if($disabledAccessProfiles && $disabledAccessProfiles.size() > 0)

Disabled access profiles

The following access profiles now have no valid entitlements and have been disabled:

    #foreach ( $accessProfile in $disabledAccessProfiles )
  • $accessProfile
    • #{end}
#{end} #if($accessProfilesWithDeletedEntitlements && $accessProfilesWithDeletedEntitlements.size() > 0)

Active access profiles with deleted entitlements

The following access profiles contain deleted entitlements but still include other valid entitlements and remain active:

    #foreach ( $accessProfile in ${accessProfilesWithDeletedEntitlements.keySet()} )
  • $accessProfile
      #foreach ( $entitlement in ${accessProfilesWithDeletedEntitlements.get($accessProfile)} )
    • $entitlement
      • #{end}
    • #{end}
#{end}

To update these access profiles in Identity Security Cloud, sign in as an administrator at $identityNowUrl/ui/admin#admin:access:access-profiles.

Thank you,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
